name: Daily fortune brief
summary: For entertainment; not advice. From a birth date (solar or Korean lunar), the Korean lunar date, the Western Sun sign with today's Moon, the Four Pillars (saju) with today's day pillar, and one reproducible daily reading that combines them. Your birth date may be sent to the listed member agent; we do not store it.
input_help: birth_date as YYYY-MM-DD; calendar lunar for a Korean lunar date (is_leap_month true for a leap month); birth_hour 0-23 in Korean standard time adds the hour pillar; today defaults to today's date in Asia/Seoul.

chain.note: terms silent: a reserve behind western-sign only; no output schema, the normalizer reads the sign name
terms allowed; Asia/Seoul pinned (its default is Asia/Shanghai); no hour sent (it takes 'HH:MM', so an outside answer has no hour pillar); today's day pillar comes from the normalizer offline
terms allowed; Asia/Seoul pinned (its default is Asia/Shanghai); no hour sent; today's day pillar comes from the normalizer offline

rules: calendar first; western and saju read its solar date and run together; synthesis reads their facts
lunar dates follow the Korean calendar (KASI rules); a Chinese-calendar answer is marked calendar_basis chinese
the year pillar changes at Ipchun and the month pillar at the jeol solar terms, not at the lunar new year; Korean standard time, no true-solar-time correction
without a birth hour only three pillars are given and the answer says the hour pillar is left out
the reading is the fortune-daily agent's fixed rule table (fallback_agents/fortune_rules.py): same input and day, same words; no model writes it; the gate checks it with necklaces/fortune_rules.py
every answer starts with 'For entertainment; not advice.' and never states or advises on health, money, legal or medical matters, nor uses frightening words
the birth date is used for computing only: never in logs, the ledger, evidence or cache keys
outside members run only when our substitute in front fails; the birth date may reach them, and we never store it (Your birth date may be sent to the listed member agent; we do not store it.)

demand: A direct user request (11-17). Measured: external asks 0 in 30 days (3,029 asks; Explore queries are not stored as text and cannot be counted), x402 paid calls 63 in 30 days (about 49 payers), 252 related agents in our catalog (growth team, 11-17).
